title: Research: the QQ16 shear prefix needs exactly sixteen native lines
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This prices the initial-prefix part of the typed-fusion question that [PR #2252](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2252) leaves open for [PR #2216](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2216)'s paired QQ16 shear. **The shear followed by B1's first eight X_T normalizations needs exactly sixteen atomic single-field native lines** at the fixed physical boundary. The inherited prefix has eight, so fusing the shear into this prefix at no extra line cost is impossible in the stated model; a typed prefix that uses the existing owned C0 attains sixteen.

- **Endpoint:** after factoring the common completed frame F, each actual pair `(A_j, T_j)` must go from `(a, t, v)` to `a' = a`, `t' = C_q^-1 (t + a)`, `v' = v - C_q^-1 a`, with every other data field and borrowed helper unchanged.
- **Lower bound:** on the payload character `chi_w`, `C_q^±1` acts as `i^(±(q·w))`. Every actual label `q_T = [289, 274, 268, 448, 478, 493, 499, 319]` has bit 8 set, so between characters 0 and 256 each inverse line changes from 1 to -i. Rows `(t', v')` and columns `(a, t)` of the difference give eight blocks `d·[[1, 1], [-1, 0]]` with `d = -1 - i`, a 16-by-16 minor of determinant `d^16 = 256`. Payload-independent scalar gates have zero character difference and each single-field native line has difference rank at most one, so telescoping the product gives **at least sixteen lines for any finite circuit** in the model, even with free scalar mixing, scratch, copies and clears.
- **Attaining word:** sixteen native lines, 32 internal native wrapper maps, 24 complex scalar ADDs, 16 owned CLEARs, eight private sweeps and no explicit cover maps (scalar real-primitive bound 224, counted separately). Every data and borrowed-helper endpoint is preserved and C0 is cleared.
- **Status:** a scoped proof for a restricted operation model, with an exact finite certificate. Not an exhaustive search or a universal supplier tariff; no supplier or κ change.

**Remaining obligations.** Explicit owner and cover maps, payload-address mixing, frequency-dependent coefficients, shared or split native wrappers, multi-field native primitives and fusion past the first eight normalizations are outside the model, so fusion at a later B1 cut remains open. The retained F0/core contract and native admission are inherited, not cold-replayed. No full B1 replay, controller recovery, tap analysis, physical schedule, hosting, precision or all-size admission, formal proof or independent human review.

## Task and overlap

- **Task ID / scope key:** `centre-path-sharing` (`a55534776f5479f1686c`), changed to `QQ16/F0-B12/shear-plus-initial-normalization/no-cover-map/native-line-minimum`. Chooser nonce `65caf5d8d22a40513a218a490c257348`, track recursive-interfaces, priority revision 4; no reroll. The question was first claimed under the chooser's third suggestion, `joint-query-controller`. Because a concurrent claim from this account already held that card (PR #2326, the full tap kernel), it was recorded under the second suggestion before any substantial computation, as a native-overhead side result for the centre-free QQ16 replacement. It does not complete that card's supplier gate. `coverage-law-change` was passed over for lack of a concrete new identity.
- **Base and exact heads:** base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, rechecked unchanged at 05:27 UTC; contribution `6b2717ce2bbb13c2152e64efea48867b78840bbb`. Retained PR #1969 `a6e6ad3936f67b8f63b5b68c5e75d540610a65e7`; context PR #2216 `b80e9ba43367fb8b20877a97da1cb677c34f9264`, PR #2252 `6dd49c2b186e08ef1f3efd08f62e1add97ff04a3` and PR #2268 `daf44bfc752a5e89127defa1cb296210708cf7e6`. No pending executable is imported; `SOURCES.json` pins every consumed main input by Git blob and SHA-256.
- **Scope status:** changed: the bare-scalar shear, which PR #2252 shows is invalid, is replaced by arbitrary scalar refactorizations plus paid native conversions, with the complete prefix endpoint fixed.
- **Nearest work:** PR #2252 proves the frame mismatch without a line-count bound; PR #2216 gives the logical shear and a payload-constant witness; PR #2268 adds a logical tap with the same typed premise. PR #2306 and this account's PR #2326 study information loss, and this account's PRs #2153, #2174 and #2189 study retained observations and moments; none prices these native lines.
- **Claim and final check:** the claim is in [discussion #2205](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2205#discussioncomment-18941102). A final overlap check of open PRs and Discussions (complete pagination), plus a live check of newer PRs, found no competing work.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-shear-prefix-cost --check-only
python3 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-shear-prefix-cost
```

Linux x86_64, CPython 3.12.3, standard library. The registered replay (normal and optimized, plus a Git-free read-only export) was run again on the final package bytes before submission, under an 8 GiB memory cap: it passed in about 9 seconds and left the worktree unchanged.

```text
PASS_QQ16_SHEAR_PREFIX_COST minimum_lines=16 inherited=8 additional=8 characters=512 inputs=712 controls=14
PASS_QQ16_PREFIX_ARTIFACTS relocated_readonly_optimized=1 source_and_typed_artifact_rejections=3
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/qq16-shear-prefix-cost outcome=completed
```

- The replay checks all 512 active characters and 712 field forms (364,544 sparse rows), 4,096 actual native-recipe basis columns, the exact determinant 256 and the difference-rank histogram `{0: 32, 8: 448, 16: 32}`. A separate physical convolution interpreter executes 25 participating-field inputs at address zero; translation equivariance covers their 12,800 shifted inputs, which are not executed one by one.
- Thirteen semantic controls reject malformed claims, and one deliberately shows the constant-payload blind spot. Three source and typed-artifact corruptions are rejected.
- I rechecked the key step by hand: `C_q = ((1+i)I + (1-i)T_q)/2` acts as 1 or i on a character, all eight labels have bit 8 set, each block has determinant `d^2`, and `d^16 = (2i)^8 = 256`.

## Open next questions

See the package README and `TASK.json`. The smallest useful follow-up: choose a later B1 cut, derive its complete physical endpoint, and test whether later operations absorb the eight extra lines; stop if its favorable charged budget still loses.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

- **What helped:** PR #2252 stated plainly that it gave no line-count bound, so the open question was exact.
- **Friction:** the generic `joint-query-controller` task query matched most of the busy board; the mechanism terms and the predecessor's open question were needed. A concurrent same-card claim appeared between the first read of the claims and the claim's creation, and a reread caught it before any substantial computation.
- **Suggestion:** this account's PR #2154 (task terms from package roots) addresses the first point; one documented example that combines a task query with a mechanism phrase would help too.
